get.summary: Export a template the current user may view as a portable JSON document.
get.description:
The response body is the export document itself (no wrapper), so the downloaded file is exactly the contract issue #31 will import. Requires the same view permission as the detail endpoint; unauthorized requests are rejected without exposing any template content.
Export a template.

post.summary: Import a portable template export document as a new DRAFT template.
post.description:
The request body must be the export document itself (the same shape the export endpoint returns), not a wrapper. Nextcloud decodes a JSON request body into `getParams()`, so an authored empty configuration object `{}` and an empty array `[]` both arrive as an empty PHP array and are treated identically. Creation policy and ownership are enforced by the authoring service, never by the client.
The size limit is the canonical compact UTF-8 encoding of the decoded document, enforced by the service. The installed `IRequest` API exposes no raw request body, so a client-declared `Content-Length` is deliberately not consulted: it is not proof of the actual body length.

tags.name: page
tags.description: Renders the main Runbook application page that mounts the Vue frontend.

tags.name: acl
tags.description: JSON endpoints for template access control lists.

tags.name: activity
tags.description: Read-only JSON endpoint for the append-only run activity history.

tags.name: admin_settings
tags.description: Administration settings endpoints. The read and write endpoints are intentionally not annotated with `#[NoAdminRequired]`, so Nextcloud only allows administrators to call them. The read-only `features` endpoint is available to authenticated users so the main application can reflect globally disabled features in its UI.

tags.name: attachment
tags.description: JSON and download endpoints for run step evidence.

tags.name: comment
tags.description: JSON endpoints for run and step comments.

tags.name: migration
tags.description: Administration endpoints for the legacy AppData migration (issue #55). Both endpoints are administrator-only: they are intentionally not annotated with `#[NoAdminRequired]`.

tags.name: principal
tags.description: JSON endpoint used by the ACL editor to search Nextcloud users and groups.

tags.name: run_acl
tags.description: JSON endpoints for a run's participant and viewer list.

tags.name: run
tags.description: JSON endpoints for the run lifecycle.

tags.name: run_section
tags.description: JSON endpoint for editing a run section's notes and returning its steps.

tags.name: run_step
tags.description: JSON endpoints for executing individual run steps.

tags.name: status
tags.description: Minimal read-only status endpoint of the Runbook foundation It exists solely to verify that the Vue frontend can reach the PHP backend. It does not implement any business logic.

tags.name: template
tags.description: JSON endpoints for template metadata and lifecycle.

tags.name: work
tags.description: JSON endpoints for "My Work" and the overview counters.
